webhookDeploys.title: Webhook deploys
webhookDeploys.description: App-global pause for CI / push / scheduled deploys. Manual deploys from the UI or CLI keep working so you can still ship a fix.
webhookDeploys.scopeNoteLive: Webhook-fired deploys (push, CI, scheduled) accept normally. Pausing stops all three; manual deploys remain available.
webhookDeploys.scopeNotePaused: Webhook-fired deploys refused. Manual deploys, rollbacks, promotions, and teardown remain available.
webhookDeploys.confirmTitle: Pause webhook deploys for this app?
webhookDeploys.confirmDescription: Future deploys from CI, push events, and cron will be refused until you resume. Manual deploys from the UI or CLI continue to work.
webhookDeploys.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. CI is misfiring, holding until the upstream pipeline is fixed
webhookDeploys.reasonHelp: Recorded on the audit log and shown on this page until the pause is lifted. Up to 512 characters.

sourceProviders.title: Quellanbieter
sourceProviders.description: GitHub / GitLab / Gitea verbinden + SSH-Deploy-Keys verwalten.

notifications.title: Benachrichtigungen
notifications.description: Posteingang für Freigaben, Alerts und Einladungen.

apiTokens.title: API-Tokens
apiTokens.description: Langlebige Bearer-Tokens für CLIs und Bots.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Currency-denominated platform spend, rolled up from CostSnapshot rows. Pick a time range; the trend chart marks anomalies (> 2σ day-over-day jumps); the per-resource panel attributes spend to specific managed-service bindings.

forecast.insufficientData: Not enough daily cost data yet for a confident projection.

trend.title: Daily trend
trend.description: Per-day platform spend over the selected range. Marked points exceed the day-over-day rolling 2σ.
trend.emptyTitle: No cost data in this window
trend.emptyDescription: The daily cost collector hasn't written snapshots for the selected range yet, or the cloud-side billing API hasn't reported usage. Live pricing data only — nothing is estimated client-side.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Budgets fire alerts as you cross each percentage threshold.
budgets.emptyDescription: Budgets can be set per organization, team, or project.

byCategory.title: By category
byCategory.description: Spend split across workload / managed-service / egress / storage / other.

attribution.title: Per-resource attribution
attribution.description: Spend broken out by managed-service binding (e.g. main_db, events_queue, uploads_bucket). Untagged rows roll up under "shared / untagged" — usually shared egress or providers that don't yet apply the platform binding tag.
attribution.emptyDescription: Bindings are visible only after the cloud-side cost driver tags resources with astrolift.io/binding at provision time. Track #432 from:backend for the provider-side rollout.

audit.title: Audit-Protokoll
audit.description: Jede Berechtigungsentscheidung und jede statusändernde Mutation, append-only. Mandantenscoping auf der Datenbankebene.
audit.retentionDescription: Jede Berechtigungsentscheidung und jede statusändernde Mutation, append-only. {days} Tage gemäß Compliance-Richtlinie aufbewahrt.
audit.emptyDescription: Keine Audit-Ereignisse entsprechen den aktuellen Filtern. Erweitern Sie den Datumsbereich, löschen Sie den Aktionsfilter oder warten Sie auf neue Aktivität.

sheet.redactedNote: Sensible Werte (Geheimnisse, Tokens, Passwörter) werden vor der Anzeige maskiert.

events.title: Events
events.description: Append-only platform fact log: every state change of interest to dashboards, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.
events.emptyDescription: No events match the current filter. Try clearing it, or trigger a mutation to see one land.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.description: Resource limits per scope. Soft limits trigger alerts; hard limits block the next admission attempt.
quotas.emptyDescription: Quotas can be set per organization, team, or project. The default install ships with sensible org-level caps.

request.title: Request quota bump
request.description: Asks an org admin to raise the hard limit. They get an in-app notification + an email. Pending status surfaces on this row until decided.
request.reasonPlaceholder: Onboarding the prod team next quarter; current cap blocks the migration.
request.reasonHint: Required. Shows up in the admin notification.

mute.customDescription: Silence channel fan-out until the TTL expires. The rule keeps producing AlertEvent rows so the incident timeline stays intact. Mute is capped at 7 days.
mute.reasonPlaceholder: Known outage — DB migration in progress
mute.reasonHint: Surfaces on the audit log + on the muted-rule badge.
